gates.scope: Declared native physical-AI fixtures for shortcut commitment, recoverable wall contact, exit, missed entries and lap bookkeeping.
Native PlayerCar and manual-driver checks from declared initial states using scripted input; no human driving, rendered performance or natural campaign claim.
Five physical career rivals per course, generated native Track/AICar and World progress/traffic impulses. No player input or rendering; omitted systems remain listed in the raw report.
Static native V11 centerlines and physical shortcut construction/projection with the original geometric limits. No natural driving or phone-frame-rate conclusion.
Finish-bounded native-road curvature measurements; full V11 routes are compared with historical V9.1 geometry, without isolated pacing-only attribution or human-engagement claims.

gates.scope: Actual built-H5 Chromium UI with a simulated rewarded SDK, injected unfinished-race settlement and replayed callback/DOM events; no live ad delivery or natural race outcome.
